jobs.title: VP, Digital Experience & Growth
jobs.description:
**VP, Digital Experience \& Growth**


**Job Type**: Full time  

**Location**: Toronto  

**Reporting to**: CEO  

**Role Type:** New



Goway Travel was founded in Toronto in 1970 by Bruce Hodge, a young Australian economist who moved to Canada to follow his dreams.



From there, we have established ourselves as a global influence with offices in Toronto, Vancouver, Los Angeles, Sydney, and Manila. While the travel industry endured major challenges, our strong foundations allowed Goway to forge ahead. We continually innovated, invested in new technology, and challenged the status quo.



Still owned and operated by Bruce, with the support of his leadership board, our mission has always been to help our clients realize their travel dreams. Today, we are an industry\-leading, global travel company with over 800 employees. Our team of experts utilizes cutting\-edge technology to tailor\-make 4 and 5\-star travel experiences in over 100 countries around the world.



At Goway Travel, we're not just a company; we're a family of dreamers and doers, inspired by our founder’s incredible journey. He didn't just follow a career path; he followed his heart, and in doing so, he built a company that helps others follow theirs.



If you’re passionate about travel and innovation, we invite you to be a part of our exciting journey!


**Job Purpose**:


As our first Vice President, Digital Experience \& Growth, reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll own the digital growth engine end to end: the website, search, performance marketing, lifecycle, and the data that ties it all together. This is a rare seat where strategy and hands\-on craft meet, and where your work shows up directly in revenue.



If you thrive in an environment where innovation meets real\-world impact, this role offers the opportunity to shape the technology behind unforgettable journeys.


**What will be your key responsibilities?**



* Own the vision, governance and performance of Goway’s web properties and portals, leading CRO, UX, merchandising and customer\-journey improvements.


* Shape strategy across paid, organic search, referral and emerging channels, tying investment to revenue, profitability, lead quality and long\-term customer value.


* Build lifecycle strategy for Direct travellers and Trade partners, including journeys, nurture programs, re\-engagement flows, advisor communications, personalization, loyalty, retention and referral.


* Build reporting that links marketing activity and website performance to business results, and partner with Technology on segmentation, audience strategy, lead\-quality analysis and customer data strategy.



**Required Skills and Qualifications**:


* 15\+ years of progressive leadership in digital marketing, digital product, e\-commerce, lifecycle, growth, CRM, analytics or customer experience.
* A track record of leading digital transformation or growth initiatives that moved the numbers.
* Hands\-on strength in website optimization, SEO, acquisition, conversion, personalization and retention.
* Deep fluency in CRM, journey orchestration, marketing automation, analytics and martech, with the ability to lead across Marketing, Technology, Sales and Operations.


**What can you expect from Goway?**  

Imagine working for a company where your career feels like an adventure. At Goway, you’ll join a global community that supports one another:


* We offer a competitive salary accompanied by performance incentives, and we place real importance on time away from work, such as paid personal days for when life calls for them and your birthday off each year.
* Your future matters to us, so we match your RRSP contributions and provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Our commitment to professional growth means you’ll have access to continuous learning and industry\-leading training that keeps you at the forefront of travel innovation.
* Travel is in our DNA, so you’ll enjoy exclusive perks and discounts on worldwide getaways.
* Since we operate across Toronto, Vancouver, Los Angeles, Manila, Sydney, and beyond, you’ll collaborate across cultures and shape a career path that reflects your ambitions.
* Goway is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate differences and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace for everyone. We appreciate every applicant’s interest. Please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.


**How to Apply:**  

If this role feels like your next step, click "Apply Now" to create your profile, upload your CV, and share a few details about yourself. Our talent team reviews every application, and if your experience aligns with our needs, we will reach out to set up the next step.


**AI Screening Disclosure**  

To help us fairly and efficiently review applications, we use an automated screening process to assess responses to pre\-determined questions. This initial step ensures all candidates are evaluated consistently. Qualified applicants will be reviewed by our recruitment team for further consideration.


**Additional Notes**  

Goway Travel Ltd will retain applications, notifications, and records related to this posting for three years, reflecting our commitment to fair and equitable hiring practices.


**Recruitment scams \& fraud warning:**  

Please be aware of any suspicious emails or WhatsApp activity from individuals pretending to be recruiters or senior personnel at Goway Travel. We will never ask you to install an app during the recruitment process. If you receive a message of this nature, please ignore it and report it to Goway.


**About Goway**  

Founded in Toronto in 1970 by Australian economist Bruce Hodge, Goway has evolved from a one\-person dream into a family\-owned global leader in tailor\-made travel. jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 276793
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

**The Role:**  

  

This Director Level role is a strategic operational leader within the Enterprise Data and AI Platform organization, responsible for driving workforce optimization, engagement, communication, and innovation outcomes. This role enables the SVP \& CIO’s strategic agenda by ensuring that human capital, vendor engagement, and organizational communications are optimized to deliver measurable value, efficiency, and cultural impact across a global technology function.
  

  

The Director leads cross\-functional initiatives spanning workforce strategy, contract and vendor optimization, communications and branding, and innovation and early talent development, ensuring alignment with Enterprise Data and AI Platform technology roadmap and operational priorities.
  

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**  

  

  



**Portfolio Strategy \& Prioritization:**


* Translate strategic priorities into an integrated portfolio roadmap, investment plan, and delivery priorities.
* Maintain visibility of portfolio outcomes, milestones, investment decisions, and strategic trade\-offs.
* Support annual and multi\-year planning processes, including roadmap and funding decisions.
* Monitor delivery across initiatives, identifying cross\-program dependencies, risks, constraints, and execution gaps.
* Coordinate with program, product, engineering, architecture, risk, finance, and business teams to ensure portfolio alignment.
* Drive disciplined management of scope, milestones, commitments, and portfolio\-level outcomes.
**Financial \& Workforce Management:**


* Manage portfolio budgets, forecasts, actuals, and financial performance.
* Support business cases and investment decisions, including FTE, contractor, and vendor capacity requirements.
* Track workforce demand and capacity against portfolio priorities.
* Identify opportunities to optimize spend, reduce duplication, and improve return on investment.
**Executive Reporting \& Insights:**  



* Develop concise executive and SteerCo reporting on portfolio health, delivery progress, investments, risks, and decisions required.
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Establish portfolio KPIs and reporting that connect delivery progress with measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure risks and emerging issues are surfaced early with clear mitigation and decision paths

  

**Metrics, Dashboards, and Reporting:**

* Own design and governance for Enterprise Data and AI Platform’s dashboarding framework, ensuring timely, accurate, and insightful reporting for executives.
* Track and communicate key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) across workforce capacity, engagement, financial optimization, and innovation delivery.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to enhance automation, transparency, and decision support for CIO and leadership forums.

**Strategic \& Operational Leadership:**


* Contribute to strategic planning cycles, leadership offsites, and transformation programs.
Represent the Enterprise Data and AI Platform strategy and operations function across enterprise technology leadership forums.  

* 
**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:**  

  

  



* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Communications, or a related field; MBA preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in workforce management, operations, or strategic communications ideally within technology, financial services, or a professional services environment.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional programs with measurable business impact and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong financial and contractual acumen with demonstrated experience optimizing vendor and resource portfolios.
* Superior storytelling, communication, and presentation skills with experience representing senior technology leaders.
* Familiarity using analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to drive workforce and performance insights.
* Strategic thinker with a collaborative and execution\-oriented leadership style.

**What's in it for you?**  

  



* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Allyship \- We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias\-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow \& participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability \& veterans.
* Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations \- We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
* Upskilling through online courses, cross\-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
* Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
* Dynamic Ecosystem \- Free tea \& coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
* Community Engagement \- No matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement \& belonging with our various programs.

Requisition ID: 275942
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

The Director AI Business Solutions will be responsible for guiding and implementing the AI strategy across the Canadian Wealth Management (CWM) businesses, ensuring business strategies, plans and initiatives are executed / delivered in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies and procedures.
  

  

The Director AI Business Solutions will be responsible for identifying AI initiatives that are aligned with our strategic objectives, supporting the development and implementation of artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from start (rapid pilots, MVPs) to finish (deployed in production with user adoption). The role will be focused on process improvements, enhancements, or even reimagining them to support the evolution of CWM.
  

  

The Director AI Business Solutions will also be responsible for staying current with AI trends and technologies to drive innovation and maintain a competitive market edge in a manner that is compliant and trustworthy in alignment with Scotiabank’s Enterprise AI Governance framework. The role will leverage AI\-driven analytics to optimize distribution strategies, enhance efficiency and improve user engagement by identifying patterns, and streamlining processes. This role involves working with cross\-functional teams including retail and institutional distribution, finance, operations, product, technology and data.

  

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:**

  

* Align CWM’s AI priorities and initiatives with leadership across the different functional business areas
* Define CWM’s AI strategy, vision, and goals in alignment with CWM’s strategic business priorities
* Manage AI development, demand portfolio, while maintaining an opportunity pipeline
* Define objectives, metrics, KRI’s, and Key Results (OKRs) for the Business Solutions Program
* Regularly report progress on key initiatives and program outcomes to CWM leadership team, providing insights and strategic recommendations to inform\-decision making
* Establish and manage a multi\-disciplinary Business Solutions team as needed to manage and operate AI while scaling for growth
* Creates an environment in which their team pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day\-to\-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.
* Builds a high\-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.
* Assess, prioritize and develop capabilities and resources required to develop, manage, and operate the AI ecosystem
* Identify, develop and enhance necessary organizational AI skills and roles across leadership and business functions
* Ideate, prioritize, design, test, and refine AI pilot solutions
* Operate the AI practice, including the AI lifecycle, governance, and partnerships
* Drive distribution efficiency and effectiveness
* Develop and maintain AI use cases
* Monitor AI performance and risks
* Drive ROI on AI investments
* Scale AI with value and re\-use
* Drive and sustain an AI\-first innovation culture
* Conduct executive AI labs to deep dive the value of AI in investment management and how to drive a culture change towards AI adoption
* Align AI enablement efforts with the Enterprise AI Governance Framework, leverage best practices where available, and collaborate with AI experts within Scotiabank
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day\-to\-day activities and decisions.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? \- We'd love to work with you if you have:**

  

* Deep experience and knowledge of financial services and Wealth Management
* Strong business judgment and ability to translate technical concepts into actionable business strategies
* Excellent technical project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Familiarity with AI techniques, Frameworks and latest advances, as well as cloud and data platforms (e.g., Azure / OpenAI, Google Cloud Platform / Gemini), and the ability to leverage them for AI initiatives
* Strong executive communication skills, with a collaborative and results\-oriented approach
* Strong leadership skills to develop and manage a team focused on driving AI initiatives
* Ability to use an agile approach to develop key talent, capabilities and assets with a rapid prototyping mindset
* Ability to identify opportunities, manage demand, and support the development of AI use cases
* MBA, CFA and/or experience in consulting is an asset.

  

**What's in it for you?**

  

The opportunity to join a forward\-thinking and collaborative team, surrounded by innovative thinkers. Your career matters! You will have access to career development and progression opportunities. An inclusive working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success! You will get our help to save for your future and to invest in your total wellbeing through our Scotiabank benefits\*\* such as Performance Bonus, Employee Share Ownership Program, Pension Plan Matching, Banking Benefits, and Health Benefits from day one! You will relish work\-life balance, team events, and opportunities to participate in the community.
